subject: forced premature graduation (P126-F) -> governance capture / agent-alive exploitation?
resolves: P127 C2 (downstream harm of premature graduation)
primary_question: After attacker-funded premature graduation, can the attacker use the newly-alive agent/governance state for unauthorized control, value movement, or harm?
answer: No. Forced graduation makes the agent alive and lets a >=0.01% holder PROPOSE, but EXECUTING any governance/agent action requires the measured 4% quorum (4,000,000e18). Forced graduation is funded by a currency donation, granting the attacker 0 AIToken and 0 voting power; the attacker's power is graduation-mode-independent (only buying >=4% of supply meets quorum). The only stage-gated Agent functions are governance-owned (revert for the attacker directly) and setProxyImplementation is whitelist-restricted. No downstream capture/value path from forced graduation.

measured.quorum_comment_discrepancy: TokenGovernor inline comment says 25%; measured 4% (GovernorVotesQuorumFraction(4)/denominator 100). Incidental; recorded neutrally; not the P128 question; no severity assigned.
